columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.description: Indicates if a record should be explicitly inserted or updated

columns.name: LANGUAGE_USE_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Language use reference identifer used in matching

columns.name: LANGUAGE_NAME
columns.description: The standard name for a language. For example, Spanish, Mandarin, or American English. Foreign key to the FND_LANGUAGES table.

columns.name: NATIVE_LANGUAGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this language is the person's declared native language. Y for a declared native language, N for all other languages.

columns.name: PRIMARY_LANGUAGE_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates if this is the primary language used by a person in day-to-day transactions. Y for the primary language, N for other languages.

columns.name: READS_LEVEL
columns.description: User-defined level number or name to indicate the ability to read a language

columns.name: SPEAKS_LEVEL
columns.description: User-defined level number or name to indicate the ability to speak a language

columns.name: WRITES_LEVEL
columns.description: User-defined level number or name to indicate the ability to write in a language

columns.name: SPOKEN_COMPREHENSION_LEVEL
columns.description: Code to indicate comprehension of a spoken language
